question: In which of the following states was the 4th Asmita Khelo India National Judo League/Ranking Judo Tournament 2024-25 held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 4th Asmita Khelo India National Judo League/Ranking Judo Tournament 2024-25 was held in **Kerala**.
 
• This tournament is part of the **Khelo India initiative**, which aims to promote sports at the grassroots level across India.
 
• The event witnessed participation from various states, showcasing the best judo talents in the country.
 
• It serves as a platform for young athletes to gain national exposure and compete at a high level.
 
• The tournament is organized annually under the auspices of the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, Government of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khelo India Programme**

 
 
• Launched by the Government of India in 2018 to revive the sports culture in India at the grassroots level.
 
• Aims to encourage mass participation and excellence in sports.
 
• Focuses on building sports infrastructure and providing financial assistance to promising athletes.
 
• Includes initiatives like Khelo India Youth Games, Khelo India University Games, and the development of sports academies.
 
 
 
• **Judo**
 
 
• A modern martial art, combat, and Olympic sport created in Japan in 1882 by Jigoro Kano.
 
• The objective is to throw or takedown the opponent to the ground, immobilize them, or force them into submission.
 
• Judo became an official Olympic sport for men in 1964 and for women in 1992.
 
• It emphasizes the principles of maximum efficiency and mutual welfare and benefit.
